name: e2e_v11_h140
description: Blind-authored long-term-memory gate for a 王者荣耀 companion: 10 new players (2 dev, 8 test), each a different ordinary Chinese person with 9-10 sessions between 2026-01 and 2026-09. Facts come up casually, about the player and their relatives/friends; jobs, homes, phones, cars, hobbies and a relative's city change; ranks rise and fall and main heroes change; the assistant makes 3+ differently worded promises per player. Per player 16 questions: 6 facts (>=2 about other people, >=1 mentioned only in passing), 2 updates (current value; stale_any = outdated values), 2 trajectories (ordered answer_all), 2 assistant promises, and 4 negatives (an unmade promise, an unstated attribute of a mentioned person, an unmentioned person, an undiscussed topic). + 140 neutral filler sessions per player (haystack_v1.json)
